title: Patients
description: Patient files, search, registration, and duplicate merging.

picker.label: Find a patient
picker.hint: Type at least two letters or digits.

list.caption: Patient files
list.name: Name
list.searchPlaceholder: Name in Arabic or English, phone, or file number
list.emptyDescription: Register the first patient to start.
list.noMatchDescription: Check the spelling, or search by phone or file number.
list.loadFailed: The patient list could not be loaded
list.truncated_one: Showing the newest file of {{total}}. Search to narrow the list.
list.truncated_other: Showing the newest {{count}} of {{total}} files. Search to narrow the list.

form.nameRequired: Enter the name in Arabic or English

new.title: Register a patient
new.description: Either name is enough. Similar files are shown while you type.

duplicates.title: This patient may already have a file
duplicates.description: Open the existing file if it is the same person. Register a new file only if it is someone else.
duplicates.inlineDescription: Check them before registering to avoid a duplicate file.

reason.name_dob: Similar name and same birth date

duplicates.registerAnyway: Different person: register a new file

emergency.title: Emergency registration
emergency.description: Name and sex only. The file is flagged incomplete and completed later.
emergency.name: Name or description
emergency.nameHint: If the patient is unidentified, write a short description such as "Unknown man, ER".

edit.title: Edit patient details
edit.description: Changes are kept in the audit log with your name.
edit.completeDescription: Add the sex, date of birth (or age) and a phone number to complete the file.

coverage.title: Coverage on file
coverage.none: No coverage on file: the patient pays in cash.
coverage.dialogDescription: The payer pays its share by the payer's rules; the patient pays the rest.
coverage.endDescription: It stays in the file history. Visits already opened keep their payer.
coverage.percentHint: Leave empty to use the payer's rules.
coverage.loadFailed: The coverage could not be loaded

balance.title: Patient balance
balance.netCredit: The patient has a credit of
balance.loadFailed: The balance could not be loaded

merge.title: Merge a duplicate file into this one
merge.description: Find the duplicate file. This file stays; the duplicate is kept as an inactive file pointing here.
merge.keepsDescription: Allergies, coverage and future appointments move here. Invoices and payments stay on their file and show together.
merge.confirmDescription: The merge is recorded with your name, the time and this reason. It cannot be undone.

profile.noVisitsHint: Open a visit to send the patient to a clinic.
profile.mergedDescription: It was merged into file {{fileNo, bidi}} ({{name}}). Use that file for new visits.
profile.incompleteDescription: Complete the sex, date of birth and phone when the patient or a relative can give them.
profile.loadFailed: The file could not be loaded
profile.notFoundDescription: Check the link or search for the patient again.
profile.visitsLoadFailed: The visits could not be loaded
profile.loadFailedDescription: Check the connection, then try again.

quickSearch.placeholder: Patient name, phone or file number, or a page…
quickSearch.failed: Patients could not be searched. Try again.

import.title: Import patients from Excel
import.description: Upload a patient sheet, review every row, then register the valid ones.
import.notAllowedTitle: Import is not available to you
import.notAllowed: Importing data needs the system administrator's permission.
import.columnsHelp: The first row names the columns, in Arabic or English. Required: a name (Arabic or English) and the sex. Optional: date of birth or age, phone, other phone, address, national ID, emergency contact and phone, notes. Up to 2,000 patients per file.
import.uploadFailed: The file could not be read
import.doneDescription: Rows skipped: {{skipped}}. Rows with errors, not imported: {{errors}}.
import.rowsFailed: The rows could not be loaded
import.caption: Rows of {{file}}
import.noProblems: No errors or duplicates in this file.
import.errorsNotImported: Rows with errors are not imported; fix them in the file and upload it again.

hint.national_id: Same national ID as file {{fileNo, bidi}} ({{name}})
hint.name_dob: Similar name and same birth date as file {{fileNo, bidi}} ({{name}})

import.includeDuplicates_one: Also register the possible duplicate (I checked it is a different person)
import.includeDuplicates_other: Also register the {{count}} possible duplicates (I checked them)
import.confirmDescription_one: 1 patient will be registered with a new file number.
import.confirmDescription_other: {{count}} patients will be registered with new file numbers.
